question: What is GCC-as-a-Service (GCCaaS)?
answer: GCC-as-a-Service is our model for establishing and operating a dedicated Global Capability Center on your behalf. We handle location selection, legal setup, compliance, hiring, and day-to-day operations through Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) or Build-Operate (BO) engagements, with dedicated teams aligned to your culture, processes, and architecture.
